_note: Per-ACT-rule overrides for practice cases. `tests` carefully selects the Trusted Tester test(s) for MULTI-test SCs (single-test SCs auto-use their sole test; understanding-only SCs auto-show the Understanding doc). `desc` is a 1-sentence plain-English description of what the rule checks. Keyed by ACT ruleId. Re-run build-practice.js after editing.

59796f.why: 7.A checks the image's accessible name is an adequate text equivalent for its meaning/purpose.
59796f.desc: An image that acts as a button must expose a non-empty accessible name so its purpose is announced.

23a2a8.why: 7.A checks a meaningful image carries an equivalent text alternative.
23a2a8.desc: A meaningful image must have a non-empty accessible name (text alternative) that conveys its information.

a25f45.why: Data-table tests 14.A/14.B verify the programmatic header/data-cell relationships.
a25f45.desc: In a data table, each cell's headers association must reference real header cells in the same table.

c4a8a4.why: 12.B checks the title actually describes the page's topic or purpose.
c4a8a4.desc: The page title must describe the page's topic or purpose — not merely exist.

2779a5.why: 12.A checks a non-empty title element is present.
2779a5.desc: The page must have a non-empty <title> element.

c487ae.desc: A link must have a non-empty accessible name so its purpose can be determined.

80af7b.desc: Keyboard focus must be able to move away from every focusable element — no keyboard trap.

36b590.desc: When input is rejected, the error message must identify the field in error and describe the problem.

afw4f7.desc: Normal-size text must meet at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against its background.

0va7u6.desc: Information should be real text, not an image of text, unless the image is essential or customizable.

0ssw9k.desc: All functionality, including scrollable regions, must be reachable and operable with the keyboard alone.

akn7bn.desc: An iframe containing interactive elements must remain reachable in the sequential focus order.

047fe0.desc: Non-repeated page content should be organized using section headings.

cc0f0a.desc: A form field's label must describe what the field is for.

oj04fd.desc: An element in the sequential focus order must show a visible focus indicator when focused.

e086e5.desc: A form field must have a programmatically determinable accessible name.

97a4e1.desc: A button must have a non-empty accessible name.
